comparison.objective: Both install a long rigid component at a designated server-rack unit. Candidate installs a depth-spanning load-bearing rail; record fits a front blanking panel.
comparison.physical_skill: Both require rack-unit recognition, bimanual support, and alignment of two separated attachment points. Candidate additionally tests handed front/back orientation, simultaneous tab-and-paired-prong insertion, preserved front engagement during telescoping rear alignment, spring return, and screw driving; record pushes two simple slip-fit clips into front-post holes.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires four front/rear prongs, full spring extension, same front/rear rack unit, correct bottom-hole screws, self-support, and 3 s release; record requires both panel ends home at U6 and 1 s release, with no retention spring, rear post, telescoping, or screw criterion.
comparison.reason: This is the closest objective neighbor, but the candidate's defining tested ability is staged load-bearing attachment across rack depth, not frontal two-peg placement. The distinction depends on retaining those stages; candidate still lacks numeric rack-level, prong-depth, spring-travel, force, deformation, and screw-torque thresholds.
